paragraphs: Before service, attendants set tables, restock supplies, and clean the area. During service, they run food, clear dishes, wipe tables, and reset them immediately. When the bar is busy, they wash and stack glasses and deliver lemons and ice. After the peak, they deep-clean floors and bins, restock, and close the area.
